remarks: Tucked away in a coveted North Stamford cul-de-sac, this meticulously maintained home blends contemporary design with natural beauty. Vaulted ceilings and oversized windows fill the space with light and showcase breathtaking views. The open floor plan features hardwood floors, four striking stone fireplaces, and generous family spaces - ideal for entertaining. The modernized chef's kitchen boasts a center island, stainless steel appliances, and ample storage. Step outside to an expansive deck overlooking a beautifully landscaped yard, custom "freeform" in-ground pool with flagstone decking, and private backyard oasis. A whole-house generator and dual well system ensure peace of mind. The luxurious primary suite is a serene retreat with vaulted ceiling, stone-front fireplace, a spacious spa-like bathroom, walk-in closet, and panoramic windows overlooking the picturesque backyard. The finished walk-out lower level has a recreation room and 5th bedroom with full bath - perfect for in-laws, a nanny, or home office. With newer bathrooms, updated lighting, and replacement Anderson windows and doors, this home is move-in ready. A contemporary retreat offering unparalleled privacy, elegance, and comfort, perfect for modern living and entertaining.  OFFERS DUES TUESDAY, FEB. 25 BY 5:00 PM.
